positions.description: Selected by the economics department to be a student representative at faculty meetings and discussions, I help provide feedback and input on department activities, classes, and other decisions handled by the economics faculty.

positions.title: Writing Consultant
positions.description:
Every week, I provide consultation for writing assignments through Truman State University's Writing Center. 

The goal of the Writing Center is to improve a student's ability to communicate through the medium of writing. From research papers to literature analysis, I help students of all grades improve their papers for whatever classes they require assistance.

I also serve as the designated writing consultant to Economics 210: Sophomore Seminar, where I assist each student throughout the year on their two major research assignments in the class.

Focus areas are Western history, economic history, economic theory, political theory, Western philosophy, and general research papers.

As a part of this grant, recipients also attend ICFP proper in addition to the PLMW workshop.

projects.title: Open Tabularius
projects.description:
(Work in progress!)

Open Tabularius was the result of a weekend hackathon at UMKC called RooHack and is my first attempt at giving back to Kansas City with open source software! A local charter school asked for a solution for its student analytics that involved tracking data such as attendance, disciplinary records, and grades across the charter system. This solution would also streamline the data pipeline process, removing tedious and unnecessary manual intervention and formatting on the part of the school's head of student data. The purpose of this project, to quote her directly, "is to make every decision data based." This project is still in the works as I work along with and develop a solution in line with what the charter system administration needs.

projects.title: MyGovCost.org re-branding
projects.description:
For 2015, Independent Institute engaged in a re-branding process of its main website and MyGovCost.org, a tool created for public awareness of government spending and debt. My role in the re-branding process was:
-Creating a new site map/website outlay for improved navigation for target audiences
-Optimizing the organization of the websites content, minimizing redundancy and clutter
-Rewriting the entirety of the website's spending categories and FAQ
-Social outreach campaign through media contests, etc

organizations.name: Truman ACM
organizations.description: In January of 2017, I was elected as webmaster for the Truman State ACM chapter. I will be giving the website a massive overhaul this semester after previous webmasters failed to fulfill their duty and hope to create a template that will remain sustainable well after my tenure in this position.
